context: Tests durable automatic execution checkpoints in Koog 1.3, including a concrete JDBC provider, schema migration and a stable session identifier for crash recovery.

checklist.name: Installs the Persistence feature
checklist.description: Installs ai.koog.agents.snapshot.feature.Persistence in the AIAgent trailing lambda with automatic persistence enabled. Explicit replay alone does not write new checkpoints.

checklist.name: Adds the JDBC persistence backend dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-features-persistence-jdbc to build.gradle.kts at 1.3.0 with each artifact on its stable or beta line — the developer named JDBC explicitly. Does not add an in-memory backend (would not survive restarts) or a different backend than asked

checklist.name: Configures the backend with the JDBC connection
checklist.description: Assigns a concrete JDBC PersistenceStorageProvider to storage, configures a datasource using environment credentials, and migrates the checkpoint schema. An empty install block or TODO is insufficient.

checklist.name: Uses current checkpoint packages and types
checklist.description: Uses ai.koog.agents.snapshot.feature.Persistence and JDBC provider types from ai.koog.agents.features.persistence.jdbc. Does not import a nonexistent ai.koog.agents.features.persistence.Persistence or core.persistence.AgentCheckpointData.

checklist.name: Demonstrates a valid restart path
checklist.description: Recreates the planner agent against the same durable provider and runs with the same stable sessionId so Persistence restores the latest non-tombstone planner checkpoint automatically. Does not pass a planner checkpoint to Persistence.runFromCheckpoint: Koog 1.3 explicitly restores GraphAgentContextData in that helper.

checklist.name: Notes serializability requirement for storage
checklist.description: Notes that saved node outputs and storage values must serialize with the configured serializer. Custom data classes need a supported serializer such as Kotlinx @Serializable; unsupported outputs can cause checkpoints to be skipped.
